entries.note: The site's UN layer places Cannabis and cannabis resin in Schedule I of the Single Convention on Narcotic Drugs, 1961. Ethiopia is a party to the Single Convention, 1961, as amended by the 1972 Protocol (1994-10-11; unamended Convention by accession 1965-04-29), per the site's UN Treaty Collection data. Not named in any Ethiopian list read (National List of May 2017, Parts I-IV and Annex forms; EFDA tramadol notice; Directive No. 1121/2025, readable part). The Proclamation fixes no date and no schedule numbers for the reference; whether it reaches substances scheduled internationally after 28 February 2019 is unsettled (see 'unsettled'). Art. 2(11) speaks of 'a medicine' (Amharic መድኃኒት); whether it reaches a narcotic drug that is not used as a medicine is a question of interpretation (see 'unsettled'). The National List's Introduction mentions 'coca and its derivatives' and 'cannabis' only in running text, as examples of substances 'classified under international law as controlled drugs'; this is not a list entry.
